handbookNote: New Mexico's Revised Uniform Law on Notarial Acts (RULONA), NMSA 1978, Chapter 14, Article 14A, Sections 14-14A-1 to 14-14A-32 (enacted by Laws 2021, ch. 21, substantially amended by Laws 2023, ch. 110 / Senate Bill 246) -- which replaced the former Notary Public Act (former 14-12A-1 to 14-12A-26 NMSA 1978) and includes New Mexico's detailed 2021/2023 electronic and Remote Online Notarization (RON) provisions, the 45-day post-approval official-stamp registration deadline enforced by the Secretary of State, and the state ethics commission's disciplinary authority -- price matches this project's established $9.99 Notary tier, not a placeholder
